unmatched_system.text: The sunflower race on our street has a clear leader and a lot of quiet resentment.
Bat walk from the churchyard at dusk Friday. Detectors provided, whispering encouraged.
The new taco truck by the station has a queue worth joining. The green salsa is the move.
The library summer reading challenge sign-ups open. The medals are apparently very shiny this year.
Strawberry stall at the farm gate is back. Arrive early, they were gone by ten last Saturday.
Night market on the square Thursday: street food, records and the honey stall everyone queues for.
Wild swimming group meets at the weir field gate at seven. Water is finally warm enough to be smug about.
Choir in the park Thursday evening: bring a picnic, requests taken loudly.
